summary: Visa agency offering to apply for the 5-year Destination Thailand Visa through the Digital Nomad route on the client's behalf.

facts.label: DTV route
facts.value: Applies via the Digital Nomad/Remote Worker route on the client's behalf
facts.quote: We will apply via the Digital Nomad/Remote Worker route on your behalf.

facts.label: Total cost
facts.quote: Total cost is ฿35,000 Thai Bhat or €1,000 Euro.

facts.label: Processing time
facts.value: Approval takes between 3 days and 3 weeks

facts.label: Visa validity
facts.value: Multiple-entry, valid 5 years, 6 months per entry
facts.quote: It is valid for 5 years from the delivery date and allows stays of 6 months per entry in Thailand.
